title: Outstandingly Fluffy American Chicken Tagine
description: A sour and fluffy American dish featuring palm sugar and a tagine cook method, perfect for a date night and dairy free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the palm sugar, nam tan pip, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl.
Rub the sugar mixture all over the chicken pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
